_comment: Example of the user config file. The real file is config.json in the app's per-user data directory (shown by Storage -> Locations in the app) and is gitignored. Edit it via Settings -> Configuration, or by hand while the app is closed. A key set here overrides both .env and the built-in defaults.
_comment_google: GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET and GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN are secrets: they are masked in the Settings UI and never sent to the renderer. Get a refresh token with 'npm run gmail-auth', or with the Connect Google button in Settings.
